name: Provide
overview: Scripture reveals that God faithfully provides for His people according to His perfect plan and righteousness. Believers are encouraged to seek God's kingdom first, trusting that all necessary things will be added to them, reflecting His loving provision demonstrated supremely in the gift of His Son. The Holy Spirit is also given as a divine provision to teach and remind believers of Christ's truth, empowering them to live in accordance with God's will. This provision is closely tied to God's promise of peace and a hopeful future for those who trust in Him.
